in_sanskrit.name: Mahipalsinh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of mountains, mighty
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mahipalsinh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mahipal is the lord of mountains. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'mahi' meaning 'great' and 'pal' meaning 'mountain'. In Hindu mythology, Mahipal is considered to be the guardian of mountains and is revered as the god of stability and protection.

in_hindi.name: महीपालसिंह
in_hindi.long_meaning: मही (माँ) + पाल (पालाना वाला) + सिंह (लोहे पर वसने वाला शिव)
